THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: Perfect competition is allocatively efficient when price equals marginal cost and productively efficient when firms produce at minimum average total cost. The benchmark requires private and social marginal costs to align. Apply the exact efficiency conditions and distinguish behavioral assumptions from welfare assumptions. Minimum average total cost represents the least-cost scale for producing that output in the benchmark.
